leakage_controls: Strict train-only scaling/PCA/StageFeatureEncoder; post-calendering spectra and measurements strictly masked pre-decision via InformationHorizon.
supported_claim: On the physical Warwick Ultrasonic dataset, non-destructive ultrasonic spectroscopy alone provides predictive signal for post-calendering anode thickness (Ridge R² = 0.835, StageAware R² = 0.501). For anode density, Ridge fusion improves prediction from R² = 0.803 to 0.835. The neural StageAware model achieves R² = 0.837 (tabular) and 0.709 (fused), showing no fusion gain on this target.
unsupported_claim: Does NOT claim neural StageAware fusion gain on anode density (StageAware R² = 0.837 -> 0.709); StageAware performance was weak on the smaller cathode cohort (N=18); does NOT demonstrate closed-loop recipe optimization or electrochemical cycling improvement; validates stage-state transition prediction (z_t + u_{t+1} -> z_{t+1}) only.
allowed_slide_wording: Ultrasound alone provides predictive signal for anode thickness (Ridge R² = 0.84). Ridge fusion improves anode-density prediction from R² = 0.80 to 0.83. The StageAware model does not show a fusion gain on the same target (R² = 0.84 -> 0.71).
